## A richer note

Standard Markdown works alongside a small Astro component.

<Callout title="Something to remember">
  <p>This callout is rendered as static HTML, without client hydration.</p>
</Callout>

## An expression

MDX can evaluate an expression at build time: **{2 + 2}**.
